messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock MVP cuts by EOD tomorrow to keep the April 14 launch. I've sketched a priority cut list based on customer signals and risk. Paste below.

carlos: can you drop the list? also what's the blocker for the analytics piece?

anya: list:
- remove tenant-level A/B (v1)
- postpone multi-region routing (v1)
- soft-launch only: single model family, no runtime switching
- cut advanced batch-awareness autoscaler (defer)
- keep: core API, console basic dashboards, rollouts (canary)

mike: +1 on removing tenant A/B. customers we talked to preferred predictable latency over experiments.

jess: analytics piece is blocked by data schema work — still waiting on infra mappings. timeline 2 weeks.

olivia: +1 for keeping rollouts. customer SOCs asked for canary + automatic fallback.

anya: ok re: analytics. proposal: ship MVP without analytics, include "metrics shim" (logs only) so we can iterate quickly. Add a short note to release notes.

carlos: if we cut autoscaler we'll need to add manual runbook for spikes. who owns?

jess: eng-oncall can own runbook, I'll draft steps today. notation: scale-up via reserved pool + emergency throttle.

anya: risk: some enterprise customers expect multi-region for compliance. propose v1 target for multi-region end of Q2.

mike: action items: (1) anya update PRD with final cuts, (2) jess draft runbook, (3) olivia notify pilot customers and get signoff on limited feature set.

release-bot: Deploy plan created: milestone/launch-2026-04-14, cut_branch=scope-v1-cuts

anya: thanks all. If no objections by noon tomorrow we lock. :thumbsup:

carlos: :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup:

olivia: :+1:

mike: :raised_hands:
